description: KFLT v1 frozen vector: a fully SIGNED KFLT blob that must verify against pinnedPubkeyHex via verifyFilterBlob / verifyAndParseFilter, for @forgesworn/tessera-kit. Contradicts the (incorrect) prior claim that "signatures cannot be frozen": BIP340 aux randomness only affects producing a NEW signature, not re-verifying an already-frozen one — verify() is fully deterministic. digestHexIndependent is hand-checked via node:crypto, re-implementing computeDigest (sign.ts) with no @noble/hashes involvement, and must match the digest actually signed. Signed by a labelled deterministic demo key (NOT a real secret).
